Tests that the skipList of stepInto and stepOver does not suppress assert pauses.

Test: stepInto into a skipped range hits an assert in the skipped range
Paused with reason: step
  debugger;
  #skippedBody();
  return 0;

Paused with reason: ambiguous (assert, step)
  let a = 1;
  console.#assert(false, "assert failed");
  let b = 2;


Test: stepOver into a skipped range hits an assert in the skipped range
Paused with reason: step
  debugger;
  #skippedBody();
  return 0;

Paused with reason: ambiguous (assert, step)
  let a = 1;
  console.#assert(false, "assert failed");
  let b = 2;
